Detached execution evidence

This Tool reads records emitted by completed execution. It does not run physical projection, planning, compilation, production, runtime, or traffic work.

Rollups overlap their child stages and are never added to them. Samples carry resource evidence with zero duration. Every raw row retains its invocation owner, scope, phase, duration role, work, and resources.

Recorded resource and accounting facts include RSS, input, output, wall duration, and any component-specific numeric fields emitted by the owner.
